error_direction_rationale: Every README-listed pre-funding check is an exact equality or order comparison over the pasted values: any mismatch of a listed field is reported, and no tolerance, rounding or heuristic can hide one. The direction is conditional on the caller-supplied inputs (cluster time, expected terms, extension list), which are declared out_of_scope_by_input below with their owners; the kernel cannot detect an expected-terms block copied from the forged record itself, and says so in output_payload.expected_terms_note.

assumption_of_use.value: now — the cluster unix timestamp in seconds (Clock::unix_timestamp, validator-vote median) at which the expiry/earliest gates are evaluated
assumption_of_use.source: README Notes line 27 (cluster time, not wall-clock); supplied by the integrating client from its Solana RPC provider
assumption_of_use.owner: the integrating client fetching cluster time; a stale or wall-clock value shifts every expiry/earliest verdict, and a missing or non-numeric now is refused (NOW_REQUIRED), never defaulted from the system clock

branches.error_direction_note: This node does not derive addresses or verify PDA seeds - it recomputes the terms/owner/length checklist over pasted values only. A record whose nonce was reused, or whose escrow ATAs were derived from different seeds, is out of its declared domain; the README's checked helpers (findSwapDvpPda / verifySwapDvp) remain the on-chain instrument for that half of the checklist. Never cited as PDA-safety coverage.

branches.error_direction_note: The kernel sees destination addresses as pasted strings and cannot see account ownership; a reassigned legacy ATA at the destination address is invisible to it. Declared here rather than silently out of scope; the program's own Settle-time re-read is the control.
